decision.rationale: Official UBC graduate orientation provides public arrival guidance and welcome-event information for students joining UBC and Vancouver, with named Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies, Graduate Student Society and International Student Development organizers.

https://orientation.grad.ubc.ca/ | 7127ee3687a26fb382abb7429afba1db01de156cad08c69fb62af39cc3385a1d | Pre-arrival webinars begin in March and include Living in Vancouver with Q&A with current grad students, sessions for international students, and more.

https://orientation.grad.ubc.ca/ | 7127ee3687a26fb382abb7429afba1db01de156cad08c69fb62af39cc3385a1d | These events are brought to you by Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies, the Graduate Student Society and International Student Development.
